name: vault-reader
description: Lightweight Obsidian vault I/O plugin for searching notes, loading domain context, restoring session context, and creating session notes. Use from external projects to access vault knowledge.

hooks.prompt: The session is ending. If this session involved meaningful work (file modifications, multi-turn discussion, research, or decision-making), use AskUserQuestion to offer session-note creation with these options: [네, 기록] to create a full session-note via vault-searcher Mode 4, [간단히] to create a quick-mode session-note, [건너뛰기] to skip. If the session was trivial (simple question-answer, single lookup), do NOT prompt — just let the session end. Never auto-create a session note without user confirmation.
